key_insight: A superconducting transmon can deterministically and programmably entangle multiple phonon modes in a mechanical resonator, enabling W, GHZ, and cluster states rather than only pairwise entanglement.
engineering_relevance: This provides a scalable hardware route for multimode quantum memories, sensing, and distributed state preparation in compact mechanical devices.
method: Sequentially apply optimal-control-engineered isometries between the qubit and successive mechanical modes.
Generate matrix product states of bond dimension two in a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator.
Use the stored states for correlated-noise sensing and decoherence-contrast measurements.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports full quantum state tomography and certification of genuine multipartite entanglement among up to four mechanical modes.
watch_item: Scaling will depend on maintaining high-fidelity qubit–mode control and suppressing mode-dependent decoherence, crosstalk, and control errors.
paper_title: Deterministic and programmable generation of mechanical multipartite entangled states
